author: henri development arbiter

supersedes_in_part.note: The receipt is NOT regenerated and NOT edited. Its measurements stand. This file corrects ONE INTERPRETATION the receipt asserts about its own sample size.

retracted.claim: The cyclic protocol supplies n = 56,700 at SE = 0.00420, which makes the 0.005 bar resolvable without moving it.
retracted.why_false: The K=5 cyclic offsets pi_k(i) = (i + k) mod N RELABEL the same 11,340 pairs. They are re-indexings, not new draws, so the 56,700 (value, slot) observations are not independent. Dividing SE by sqrt(5) is PSEUDOREPLICATION: it treats one sample as five.

internal_evidence_it_is_pseudoreplicatio.reading: Five supposedly independent offsets return the SAME statistic to six decimals. Identical statistics across 'replicates' is the signature of dependence, and it was present in the artifact all along.

corrected_arithmetic.verdict: The 95% interval CONTAINS 0.005. The bar is NOT resolvable at the stated n=11340.

retracted.self_caught_defect_class: This is the SAME failure class I flagged against the blueprint's G-SJ2: a gate that asserts more than its sample can carry. The check tested the POINT ESTIMATE (|r| = 0.0 <= 0.005) and never the confidence bound. I criticised exactly this, then repeated it in the same record.

what_still_stands.measurement: r(slot, delta) = -0.000000; per_slot_trigger_rate identical across all five slots; value_has_variance true; value_sd 0.094125; max_slot_deviation 0.0 over 11,340 pairs.
what_still_stands.harness_positive_control: arm3 slot control r = -0.707107 with CI95 [-0.711199, -0.702967]. The harness DETECTS slot binding when binding exists. This is the load-bearing evidence that r=0 is not vacuous.

attribution_falsified.reading: Non-overlapping CIs. The veto fires on 82% of CORRECT candidates and 14% of incorrect ones. Unchanged by this retraction.

two_admissible_framings: POINT-ESTIMATE READING: r = -0.000000 is a sample estimate. It satisfies the 0.005 bar, but the 95% bound does not exclude |r| > 0.005 at n=11340. Margin 0.53 sigma.

CONSTRUCTIVE READING: if the veto decision is slot-independent, each cyclic offset assigns the same multiset of decisions to every slot, so the slot means are equal BY ALGEBRA and r = 0 holds by construction. The gate then cannot fail.
unresolved_index_neutrality.which_is_true: UNDETERMINED by the current evidence. The two readings differ in what must be done next: the first needs more independent pairs, the second needs a different statistic entirely.
unresolved_index_neutrality.precise_permissible_statement: The point estimate satisfies the bar. The confidence bound does not exclude |r| > 0.005 at n = 11,340. Index-neutrality is NOT proven; it is unresolved.

does_not_move_any_bar.note: No threshold was altered. The sample was misstated, so the honest conclusion weakens. Moving the bar to make the result stand is the metric-laundering failure mode this project guards against.

next_actions_for_index_neutrality: Obtain genuinely independent candidate sets (distinct queries, not relabelled slots) to raise n_eff above 153,659, the count the receipt itself computes for a 0.005 half-width at 95%.
Or state the gate as UNRESOLVED and record the constructive reading as the alternative explanation.
not_claims: No change to the veto receipt's measured numbers.
The 0.005 bar is not moved in either direction.
